description: Defines types, classes, and structures related to shader type representations and translation in the ANGLE project, including TType, TField, and related classes.

classes.name: TField
classes.description: Represents a shader field with type, name, source location, and symbol type.

classes.name: TFieldListCollection
classes.description: Manages a collection of TField objects, providing analysis functions.

classes.name: TType
classes.description: Represents a shader data type, including scalar, vector, matrix, array, struct, and interface block types.

classes.name: TPublicType
classes.description: A lightweight, trivial structure for representing shader types during parsing.

methods.name: type()
methods.description: Returns the type of the TField.

methods.name: type() const
methods.description: Returns the type of the TField (const version).

methods.name: name()
methods.description: Returns the name of the TField.

methods.name: line()
methods.description: Returns the source location of the TField.

methods.name: symbolType()
methods.description: Returns the symbol type of the TField.

methods.name: getBasicType()
methods.description: Returns the basic type of TType.

methods.name: setBasicType()
methods.description: Sets the basic type of TType.

methods.name: getObjectSize()
methods.description: Returns the size of the TType object.

methods.name: getNumArraySizes()
methods.description: Returns the number of array sizes.

methods.name: isArray()
methods.description: Checks if the type is an array.

methods.name: isMatrix()
methods.description: Checks if the type is a matrix.

methods.name: isStructSpecifier()
methods.description: Checks if the type is a struct specifier.

methods.name: getDeepestStructNesting()
methods.description: Returns the deepest nesting level of a struct type.
